final_payload.rationale_summary: Computed the growth in imports of goods and services (current US$) from 2006 to 2007 for Netherlands and Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia had a higher growth (28.00521409095411680285917746%) compared to Netherlands (19.70825945157200567505394002%). The difference is 8.29695463938211112780523744 percentage points. The result was verified via cross-check evidence.
